verdict.rationale: Proton Pass documents user-controlled deletion of its own data: the CLI can delete vaults and individual items (passwords, notes, cards, identities, SSH keys), and users can export their data. Nothing in the evidence covers retention controls, such as retention periods, trash or purge behavior, account or server-side data deletion guarantees, or retention policies. missing for 10: configurable retention policies, account-level/server-side data deletion documentation, deleted-item purge/backup retention details, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: Create, read, update, and delete vaults
View, create, update, and delete items including passwords, secure notes, credit cards, identities, WiFi entries, custom items, and stored SSH-key items
If you want to use your passwords elsewhere or create a separate hardcopy, you can easily export your data from Proton Pass.
